exposure: homozygous c.707T>G mutation in exon 4 of the CYP17A1 gene
in vitro fertilization (IVF) frozen-thawed embryo transfer
cohort: The study describes a 24-year-old Chinese female with primary infertility, primary amenorrhea, sexual infantilism, recurrent ovarian cysts, hypertension, and diagnosed with 17alpha-hydroxylase and 17,20-lyase deficiency.
finding: 17OHD females can achieve a successful pregnancy and delivery with adequate hormonal control and endometrial preparation, and luteal-phase ovarian stimulation is a convenient approach for oocyte retrieval.
mod_finding: A caesarean section was performed at 29 weeks of pregnancy due to the diagnosis of HELLP syndrome.
